noeuds.role: Runs only once, as soon as the scene starts.
noeuds.exemple: place the enemies, show the starting score or start the music.

noeuds.role: Runs over and over, on every frame of the game (about 60 times per second).
noeuds.exemple: follow the finger or check a condition all the time. Avoid putting “Play music” or “Call function” under it.

noeuds.role: Runs when the player lifts their finger from the screen, anywhere.
noeuds.exemple: stop shooting when the screen is released.

noeuds.role: Runs when the finger touches the chosen object. With a tag ("# card") as the target, it fires for every object with that tag: the touched object becomes the involved object.
noeuds.exemple: a “Jump” button, opening a chest, picking an answer.

noeuds.role: Runs when the finger is lifted above the chosen object.
noeuds.exemple: confirm a button only when it is released.

noeuds.role: Repeats on every frame as long as the finger stays on the chosen object.
noeuds.exemple: left / right buttons: while you hold them, the character moves.

noeuds.role: Repeats on every frame as long as a finger is on the screen, anywhere.
noeuds.exemple: make a ship climb while the screen is held (use doigt.x and doigt.y in formulas).

noeuds.role: Runs when the player starts dragging the chosen object (it must be “Movable (draggable in Play mode)”).
noeuds.exemple: enlarge a card when it is picked up.

noeuds.role: Runs when the player drops the object they were dragging.
noeuds.exemple: check whether a puzzle piece is in the right place.

noeuds.role: Runs once, when object A starts touching object B. They must separate before it can run again. This is also the event to use for “entering a zone”.
noeuds.exemple: the player touches the finish zone → next level.

noeuds.role: Runs once, when object A stops touching object B (it leaves the zone).
noeuds.exemple: close a door when the player walks away.

noeuds.role: Runs when the finger, sliding across the screen, reaches the chosen object.
noeuds.exemple: light up a button when the finger passes over it.

noeuds.role: Runs when the finger leaves the object it was over.
Runs when the chosen object (dynamic physics) lands on a floor or bounces.
noeuds.exemple: play a landing sound or shake the camera.

noeuds.role: Runs every time the value of the chosen variable changes.
noeuds.exemple: when “vie” (health) changes, update the health bar.

noeuds.role: Your own event, with the name you choose. It is started by the “Call event” node in the same Blueprint.
noeuds.exemple: a “GameOver” event called from several places.

noeuds.role: Runs when the player presses the scene's “BtnAction” object (action button).
noeuds.exemple: talk to a character or open a door in an adventure game.

noeuds.role: Runs once per contact when the chosen object touches an object with this tag. The touched object becomes the “Implied Object”.
noeuds.exemple: the player touches a coin (tag “piece”) → destroy the involved object and add 1 to the score.
